name: Selim III
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1789 to 1807
contribution: Regarded as an enlightened ruler, he was eventually deposed and imprisoned by the Janissaries, who placed his cousin Mustafa on the throne as Mustafa IV.
legacy: He created the Nizam-i Cedid in 1797, a European-style army trained and equipped along modern lines.

checks.lead: Selim III (Ottoman Turkish: سليم ثالث, romanized: Selim-i sâlis; Turkish: III. Selim; 24 December 1761 – 28 July 1808) was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1789 to 1807.
